sources.role: SDL/Cocoa preference, controller, save/state and boot-ROM contracts (v1.0.3)
frontend/platform support and built-in boot ROM statement
Flatpak app id io.github.sameboy.SameBoy, home access and pinned SameBoy v1.0.3 source

paths.path: ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/SameBoy/prefs.bin (SDL_GetPrefPath("", "SameBoy")); portable/resource prefs.bin beside the executable takes priority when writable
paths.naming: Binary serialized configuration_t, not a text INI: prefs.bin stores keyboard SDL scancodes, joystick button/axis indices, model/video/audio settings and the optional bootrom_path
evidence: source:SDL/utils.c resource_path uses SDL_GetBasePath and DATA_DIR @208ba4af

paths.path: Same binary ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/SameBoy/prefs.bin (or writable prefs.bin beside executable)
paths.naming: configuration.keys[GB_CONF_KEYS_RIGHT..TURBO] = SDL_Scancode values; configuration.keys_2[REWIND,UNDERCLOCK,RAPID_A,RAPID_B] = SDL_Scancode values; configuration.joypad_configuration[JOYPAD_BUTTON_RIGHT..RAPID_B] = SDL joystick button numbers (-1 unmapped), joypad_axises[0..1] = SDL axis numbers
evidence: source:SDL/configuration.h GB_CONF_KEYS_*, JOYPAD_BUTTON_* and configuration_t fields @208ba4af
source:SDL/main.c keyboard compares event.key.keysym.scancode and joystick events against those fields @208ba4af
source:SDL/gui.c controller configuration writes event.jbutton.button and axis values @208ba4af

paths.path: Beside the loaded ROM (same directory; writable path required)
paths.naming: <ROM stem>.sav for cartridge battery/RTC RAM; ISX files use <ROM stem>.ram. A .gbcart container instead contains battery.sav inside the container directory
evidence: source:Cocoa/Document.m savPath returns ROM URL with .sav or gbcart/battery.sav @208ba4af

paths.path: Beside the loaded ROM (same directory)
paths.naming: <ROM stem>.s0 through <ROM stem>.s9 for ten quick slots; loader also probes legacy <ROM stem>.sn0..sn9 when .sN is absent. A .gbcart container uses state.s0..state.s9 inside the container
evidence: source:SDL/main.c save extension .s0..s9 and legacy .sn0..sn9 load fallback @208ba4af

paths.path: No external firmware required: SameBoy ships open-source boot ROM resources. Optional custom folder is selected by the prefs.bin bootrom_path field
paths.naming: Optional folder filenames are dmg0_boot.bin, dmg_boot.bin, mgb_boot.bin, sgb_boot.bin, sgb2_boot.bin, cgb0_boot.bin, cgb_boot.bin, cgbE_boot.bin, agb0_boot.bin, agb_boot.bin; there is no canonical external checksum for these user-selected files, and built-in SameBoy boot ROMs are source-built
evidence: source:SDL/main.c load_boot_rom names[] and bootrom_path lookup @208ba4af
source:README.md features list says SameBoy includes open-source DMG/CGB boot ROMs @208ba4af
source:Makefile bootroms target and BootROMs/*.asm build the bundled images @208ba4af

paths.path: not applicable
paths.naming: SameBoy does not consume an external cryptographic key file.

notes: SameBoy's SDL frontend is used on Linux, Windows and other non-macOS systems; macOS uses the native Cocoa frontend. The Flatpak is community-provided and unverified by the upstream developer; all external boot-ROM hashes are intentionally omitted because SameBoy can use bundled open-source images and user custom files have no single canonical checksum. Save/state paths are ROM-relative by source, so a sandbox only changes access permissions, not their naming.
